# Draft:President of the Republic of Kawthoolei

----
List of presidents of the Republic of Kawthoolei is a list of individuals who have held the office of president of the Republic of Kawthoolei (also spelled Kawthooley in some sources). The republic was unilaterally proclaimed on 5 January 2026 and, as of that date, has not received formal recognition from any sovereign state or international organization
